Ape, White
Albino, herbivorous, gorilla-like apes. Live
in caves and emerge at night to forage.

AC 6 [13] HD 4 (18hp) Att 2 × claw (1d4) or
thrown rock (1d6) THAC0 16 [+3] MV 120′
(40′) SV D12 W13 P14 B15 S16 (2) ML 7 AL
Neutral XP 75 NA 1d6 (2d4) TT None
▶ Territorial: Defend their lair with
threats and, if this is ignored, violence.
